svg.text: Adaptive sonar transmitter: analog front end
All grounds (GND) are ONE common node, including the FPGA board GND
A. 8-bit R2R DAC (R = 1 kΩ, 2R = two matched 1 kΩ in series)
FPGA pins r2r[0..7] from edge_top (IOB registered). Put the best-matched resistors on the r2r[7], r2r[6] legs and the R's next to them.
B. Buffer + 2nd-order MFB low-pass filter (fc ≈ 760 kHz), one NE5532
Numbers in orange = NE5532 pin numbers. Output ≈ ±1.65 V peak at full amplitude.
C. ±9 V supply from two 9 V batteries
D. Sensor pots → XADC (build 4 of these)
scope_trig → scope EXT TRIG (trigger on rising edge) • amp_en → leave unconnected for now • FPGA GND ↔ battery GND ↔ scope GND
